title:zh-CN: 验收核验记录与有效性
description: Read-only verification snapshots; acceptance changes invalidate prior successful checks. Never rewrites stored history.
fromSql: SELECT c.pid, c.tdv_ck_name, CASE WHEN c.tdv_ck_checked_at IS NULL THEN 'pending' WHEN c.tdv_ck_checked_at<a.updated_at THEN 'stale' ELSE c.tdv_ck_status END AS tdv_ck_status, c.tdv_ck_passed, c.tdv_ck_checked_at FROM mt_tdv_check c JOIN mt_tpm_acceptance a ON a.pid=c.tdv_ck_acceptance AND a.tenant_id=c.tenant_id WHERE c.tenant_id=#{params.tenantId} AND a.pid=#{params.acceptancePid} ORDER BY c.created_at DESC,c.id DESC
